title: GAR reports on Burford’s US$600 million-plus ICC arbitration award announcement
summary: Global Arbitration Review (GAR) reports on Burford’s announcement that an arbitral tribunal constituted under the ICC Rules issued an award exceeding $600 million in favor of one of Burford’s counterparties. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Global Arbitration Review (GAR) reports on Burford’s announcement that an arbitral tribunal constituted under the ICC Rules issued an award exceeding $600 million in favor of one of Burford’s counterparties.


[Read the full article here](https://globalarbitrationreview.com/article/burford-reports-win-in-cameroon-mining-dispute) .
